title: Wednesday, October 7 — Shape of the Day
arrival: Oral storytelling and Werewolf this morning; maths after recess.
note: Confirmed plan: Wednesday oral storytelling / Werewolf runs from about 9:00 to snack at 10:20. Comparing whole numbers and decimals has not yet started; introduce it after recess. Plan without student devices. After lunch: quiet time, Nevermoor, unfinished work, community activity, then cleanup. Use the actual Nevermoor bookmark.

blocks.title: Welcome, attendance and forms
blocks.notes: Take attendance before collecting returned forms.
studentSteps: Answer attendance, then hand in any forms.
Look at today’s plan and get paper and a pencil ready.

blocks.title: Morning check-in and get ready
blocks.firstAction: Join our check-in and get ready to listen and tell stories.
blocks.firstActionKo: 아침 확인 활동에 참여하고 이야기를 듣고 할 준비를 하세요.

blocks.title: Oral storytelling / Werewolf
blocks.firstAction: Listen to the storyteller and wait for your turn.
blocks.notes: Use the familiar Werewolf routine to practise oral storytelling, listening, explaining and fair turn-taking. Take a short movement break as needed; finish at 10:20 for snack.
studentSteps: Listen to the story and follow the agreed game rules.
Keep game accusations within the fictional roles; speak respectfully.

blocks.title: Snack
blocks.firstAction: Have your snack and tidy your space.

blocks.title: Maths — introduction to comparing whole numbers and decimals
blocks.notes: First introduction, not a review. Use the board and paper. Model 342 > 324: hundreds match; compare tens. Introduce >, < and =. Compare 3.4 and 3.35 by writing 3.40 and 3.35: ones match, then 4 tenths > 3 tenths. Model 0.5 = 0.50. Together compare 506 and 560, then 2.7 and 2.65. Independent check: 428 < 482; 4.08 < 4.8; 0.6 = 0.60. Ask students to show the deciding place. Stay with whole numbers longer if needed; no devices required.
blocks.firstAction: Compare 342 and 324. Which is greater? Show the place that helps you decide.
studentSteps: Compare whole numbers by looking at the greatest place first.
Use place value to compare decimals; try the class examples.
Use >, < or = and explain which place helped you decide.
blocks.firstActionKo: 342와 324를 비교하세요. 어느 수가 더 큰가요? 판단에 도움이 된 자릿수를 보여 주세요.

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.notes: Usual intermediate routine: outside 11:50–12:12; transition 12:12–12:13; eating 12:13–12:35.
blocks.firstAction: Follow our outside-play and lunch routine.
blocks.firstActionKo: 바깥 놀이와 점심시간에는 정해진 순서대로 하세요.

blocks.title: Quiet time
blocks.notes: Preserve a calm reset; a quiet non-reading choice is available.
blocks.firstAction: Choose quiet reading, drawing or an unfinished task.
blocks.firstActionKo: 조용히 책 읽기, 그림 그리기, 끝내지 못한 활동 중 하나를 고르세요.

blocks.title: Nevermoor
blocks.notes: Make a two-column note: detail heard / what it suggests. Hear a partner’s different idea, then revise or defend your own with the text. Record the bookmark.
blocks.firstAction: Recall the last part we actually heard, or listen to the opening.
studentSteps: Listen for a character or setting detail.
Write, draw or say an idea and the detail that supports it.
Keep one question for our next reading.
blocks.firstActionKo: 지난번에 들은 마지막 부분을 떠올리거나 이야기의 시작 부분을 들으세요.

blocks.title: Work block — continue unfinished work
blocks.firstAction: Take out unfinished work and choose one next step.
blocks.titleKo: 활동 시간 · 끝내지 못한 활동 이어서 하기
blocks.firstActionKo: 끝내지 못한 활동을 꺼내고 다음에 할 일을 하나 고르세요.
blocks.notes: Use paper and available class materials. Continue unfinished work, including community solutions as appropriate. No student devices planned.

blocks.title: Community activity
blocks.notes: Use a short check-in, appreciation or familiar cooperative game. Students may speak, draw, point or pass; keep feedback specific and avoid public rankings.
blocks.firstAction: Notice one helpful action from today.
studentSteps: Offer one specific appreciation or listen.
Name a small next step for tomorrow.
blocks.firstActionKo: 오늘 도움이 된 행동 한 가지를 떠올려 보세요.

blocks.title: Cleanup, planners and pack up
blocks.notes: Complete class jobs, record confirmed reminders and pack belongings.
blocks.firstAction: Restore our room and record any confirmed reminders.
blocks.firstActionKo: 교실을 정리하고 확정된 안내 사항을 적으세요.

blocks.title: Dismissal
blocks.firstAction: Check your belongings and get ready for a calm departure.
blocks.firstActionKo: 자기 물건을 확인하고 차분히 하교할 준비를 하세요.

backups: Carry unfinished learning into the next suitable block rather than adding a second full lesson.
If the projector or sign-in fails, use paper, the board and available class materials.
